scientific_integrity: Analytical operator proof; independent verification not performed. Finite algebra checks do not certify spectral claims.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two fixed critical square-root full-branch maps and annealed dynamics. Uniform mixing rate is existential; no quenched claim. Boundary coefficients are Peano, not classical higher derivatives. Broader historical generality remains a priority risk.
title: Global Bernoulli mixing and boundary recovery for critical cusp maps
